cd /workspace && cat > config/runtime/local-builder.vars <<'EOF'

SVA_RUNTIME_PROFILE=local-builder
SVA_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000

SVA_MOCK_AUTH=true
VITE_MOCK_AUTH=true
VITE_PUBLIC_BUILDER_KEY=local-builder-dev-key
EOF
cat config/runtime/local-builder.vars
